gnn_metadata.reconciliation: Initially flagged as wrong-variant because of the in_ch=56 / rule_level_included=True fields. Reanalysis of the notebook shows Part 2 retraining slices `X_scaled[:, :-1]` and does NOT refit the scaler — so the 56-dim scaler IS the Part-2 scaler with `rule_level` as the 56th col. Slicing `scaler.mean_[:55]` and `scaler.scale_[:55]` gives the exact scaler that produced Part-2's training inputs. The 55-entry `features` list likewise excludes rule_level (saved BEFORE rule_level was appended in cell 2). Threshold differs between Part 1 and Part 2, but the plan's 13-dim state vector uses raw gnn_node_risk / gnn_neighbor_risk / gnn_risk_growth — all continuous sigmoid values — so the threshold is never invoked on the live inference path.
gnn_metadata.orderingNote: The GNN trained with ALPHABETICAL SecBERT ordering (log_secbert_emb_0, log_secbert_emb_1, log_secbert_emb_10, log_secbert_emb_11, ..., log_secbert_emb_2, ...). This DIFFERS from selected_features_top25.json (used by AE/VAE), which has NUMERIC ordering. At live inference, the feature engineer must reorder the 55-dim vector into GNN's alphabetical order before running the GNN forward pass. Use `meta['features']` as the canonical GNN ordering.
gnn_metadata.usage: GNNLoader: slice scaler to 55 cols, use meta['features'] for input column order, ignore threshold (not on critical path).

secbert_log_pca.usage: Normalizer worker: run SecBERT on _source.full_log, mean-pool to 768-dim, then pca.transform(...) to get 16-dim log_secbert_emb_0..15.

secbert_cmd_pca.usage: Normalizer worker: run SecBERT on _source.data.command, mean-pool to 768-dim, then pca.transform(...) to get 16-dim cmd_secbert_emb_0..15.

standard_scaler.contents: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler with n_features_in_=55, feature_names_in_ = selected_features_top25.json all_selected_columns (numeric SecBERT order)
standard_scaler.derivedVia: infra/scripts/derive_standard_scaler.py — slice gnn_metadata.pkl['scaler'] to its first 55 cols, permute from GNN's alphabetical SecBERT order to AE/VAE canonical numeric order. Mathematically equivalent to what VAE/AE notebooks' scaler_reduced would have produced.
standard_scaler.usage: Normalizer worker: call scaler.transform(x_55) after the 55-col vector is assembled in canonical order, before feeding to AE/VAE. The GNN path uses gnn_metadata.pkl's scaler directly (alphabetical order), not this one.
